name: Lake Shore Realty Limited
summary: Based in New Delhi, India, Lake Shore Realty Limited is an Indian firm engaged in the real estate industry. The company, which was founded in 1987, specializes in the development and oversight of projects across multiple sectors such as property, infrastructure, hospitality, education, healthcare, and industrial warehousing. It was formerly known as Mahaan Foods Limited before officially changing its name to Lake Shore Realty Limited in April 2025.
